crossRefs.note: These are the days of the years of Abraham’s life which he lived: one hundred seventy-five years.
Jacob lived in the land of Egypt seventeen years. So the days of Jacob, the years of his life, were one hundred…
So Joseph died, being one hundred ten years old, and they embalmed him, and he was put in a coffin in Egypt.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.
translations.kjv: And the days of Isaac were an hundred and fourscore years.
translations.asv: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and fourscore years.
